snippet.title: Rock Band Country Track Pack 2 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on February 1, 2011, the Rock Band Country Track Pack 2 brings 21 of the best new and classic country songs to the Rock Band franchise, ranging from acts such as Johnny Cash and Merle Haggard to Sugarland and Lady Antebellum. For a full track listing and more details, go here:

http://www.rockbandaide.com/10613/country-track-pack-2-officially-announced-setlist-revealed/
